Messages.Author: Erol
Messages.Body:
Does an independent vampire keep his title (e.g. worth 2 votes) after becoming anarch?

- Prince of Karlsruhe, Germany

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body: Yes, but remember that "2 votes" is a title, which means common ways of becomming anarch (Anarch Convert, Go Anarch, ...) won't work, and you'll have to use the other tricks (Anarch Secession).

Messages.Author: a-e
Messages.Body:
